title: Skew & distort reshapes the picture from the selection chip
goal: The chip by a picked layer's turn knob gains its middle choice, Skew & distort, as the user approved in the transform modes prototype on 2026-11-01: an edge pill slides that edge along itself to skew, a corner moves freely to distort, and Shift on a corner keystones. The reshape belongs to the picture itself, so turning, resizing and 3D act on the reshaped picture.
notes: Slice (2) of the-reworked-selection-ships-cleaner-grips-a-tag (user, 2026-11-01: split in this order). Built so far: SelectionGrips/TransformMode in PhotonzCore (TransformMode.reshape exists but TransformMode.offered leaves it out), CanvasSelectionGrips.swift draws and hits the grips, the chip icon for reshape is already drawn by chipIcon(.reshape). Prototype: docs/design/mocks/pages/selection-transform.html (corners(L, box) for the box vs reshaped corners, the distort/keystone math in the pointermove handler). Renderer: CIPerspectiveTransform, the same path 3D uses; perf note needed (composite path). The old Option-corner skew is already gone at Next defaults (next-transform-modes).
acceptance: The chip reads Size, Skew & distort, 3D in that order, at Next defaults, and the grips look the same in every mode
In Skew & distort an edge pill skews (the edge slides along its own line) and a corner distorts; Shift on a corner keystones (the corner across mirrors it); each drag is one undo step
The reshape is stored as each corner's offset in the layer's own unturned plane as a share of width and height, rendered non-destructively, and survives resize, turn and 3D
In Size and 3D the grips sit on a flat rectangle round the reshaped picture with a faint dotted outline of the reshape inside; only Skew & distort grips the reshaped corners
Layer > Transform > Skew, Distort and Keystone enter Skew & distort; a walk drives each by the pointer and the audit compares with selection-transform.html
